candidates.source_name: NBS – Zoznam dohliadaných subjektov (subjekty.nbs.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Central NBS database of all supervised entities across sectors incl. banking, payment services and e-money. Enumerates every licensed bank, foreign-bank branch, payment institution, e-money institution and agent in SK, which is the actor list every A5 (jobs/leadership) collection cell needs. Site advertises a downloadable database ('Databáza na stiahnutie'), and search results referenced an API endpoint pattern under subjekty.nbs.sk/api/.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the advertised bulk download / JSON API over HTML scraping; snapshot daily-to-weekly and diff entity lists and, where exposed, statutory-body fields.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language search for 'zoznam dohliadaných subjektov' + follow-through to the entity database host
queries_used: NBS zoznam dohliadaných subjektov platobná inštitúcia register

candidates.source_name: NBS – Registre (hub of all NBS supervisory registers)
candidates.why_relevant: Top-level index of every register NBS maintains; the cheapest way to snowball into new register endpoints (PSD2, RBUZ, register informácií/DORA, financial intermediaries) rather than guessing URLs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly crawl of the index page to detect newly added registers; treat as seed list for the register-specific collectors.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search + snowball from register result set
queries_used: NBS zoznam dohliadaných subjektov platobná inštitúcia register

candidates.source_name: NBS – Register podľa PSD2 (payment institutions, e-money institutions, agents)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory PSD2 register: the legally mandated national list of payment institutions, limited-scope providers, e-money institutions, AISPs and their agents. Underpins the payments half of the sector scope and feeds the EBA central register.
candidates.legal_status: register mandated by Zákon o platobných službách / PSD2
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly snapshot + diff of entity and agent entries; new/removed agents are an early signal of distribution and org changes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language targeted search on PSD2 register terms
queries_used: "nbs.sk" register podľa PSD2 platobná inštitúcia agent zoznam poskytovateľov platobných služieb

candidates.source_name: NBS – Výroky právoplatných rozhodnutí (final enforceable supervisory decisions)
candidates.why_relevant: The single highest-value A5 source in this cell: a filterable table of NBS decisions with issue date, entity, decision number and date of legal force, filterable by IČO, year/month, decision area and decision type. Historically these decision texts name individuals granted prior consent (predchádzajúci súhlas) to be elected to a bank's board or appointed as a senior employee reporting to the statutory body — i.e. named appointments, dated, often ahead of the bank's own press release. Also carries sanction decisions naming officers.
candidates.legal_status: statutory publication of decision operative parts
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the filter endpoint weekly by year/month and decision type; harvest detail pages (observed pattern https://nbs.sk/vyroky/<id>) and NER the person names + role phrases ('člen predstavenstva', 'vedúci zamestnanec').
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search on sanction/decision terms, then fetched the listing page to confirm table columns and filters
queries_used: nbs.sk "sankcie" rozhodnutia dohľad "vydané rozhodnutia" zoznam pokuty banka
NBS vestník rozhodnutia "predchádzajúci súhlas" 2025 banka predstavenstvo vymenovanie zverejnenie

candidates.source_name: NBS – Archív rozhodnutí (decision archive)
candidates.why_relevant: Historical backfill for the decision register — needed to build a multi-year time series of who was approved into which seat and when, and to establish tenure baselines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off deep backfill crawl, then leave dormant; re-check annually.
candidates.discovered_via_method: linked from the main decision register page
queries_used: nbs.sk "sankcie" rozhodnutia dohľad "vydané rozhodnutia" zoznam pokuty banka

candidates.source_name: NBS – Výroky neprávoplatných vykonateľných rozhodnutí
candidates.why_relevant: Decisions that are enforceable but not yet final — an EARLIER signal than the final-decisions register. Useful as a leading indicator of enforcement naming officers and of pending governance changes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly diff alongside the final-decisions register; cross-link by decision number to detect which become final.

candidates.source_name: Vestník NBS (NBS official bulletin, annual volumes)
candidates.why_relevant: Official bulletin carrying NBS opatrenia and notices, including the measures that define what a prior-consent application under §28 of the Banking Act must contain. Sets the legal frame that makes the fit-and-proper record exist, and is where procedural changes (e.g. Opatrenie 1/2025) that alter the data trail are announced.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of the year index and čiastka PDFs; alert on documents mentioning §28 / predchádzajúci súhlas.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak and English for a standalone, browsable NBS register of fit-and-proper approvals / approved key function holders (e.g. 'zoznam udelených predchádzajúcich súhlasov', 'zoznam vedúcich zamestnancov'). No such dedicated register surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Individual prior-consent approvals appear to be published only as operative parts of decisions inside the general 'výroky rozhodnutí' register and its PDF archives, not as a structured person-level dataset.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The A5 pipeline cannot rely on a clean person-role table from NBS; it must NER-extract names and roles from decision text, which raises extraction cost and error rate.

negative_findings.description: A search-result snippet referenced a codelist endpoint under https://subjekty.nbs.sk/api/ for PSD2 institution-type codes, and the subjekty.nbs.sk page advertises 'Databáza na stiahnutie'. I did not independently confirm the endpoint shape or that a full entity export exists.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk/API access is plausible but unconfirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If a real API exists it removes the need for brittle scraping of the flagship pointer source; confirming it is the highest-leverage next engineering step.

negative_findings.description: Could not confirm from the fetched subjekty.nbs.sk content whether the supervised-entity records include statutory-body member names, or only entity identity and scope of authorisation.
negative_findings.result_summary: The fetch returned navigation/sector structure only; person-level fields were not visible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines whether NBS's register alone can answer 'who holds which seat', or whether ORSR/Obchodný vestník must carry that load.

negative_findings.description: The page requiring supervised entities to inform NBS about general meetings and sessions of the supervisory board and statutory body was found under the insurance (poistovníctvo) branch. A banking/payments equivalent was not located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Mechanism confirmed for insurance; unconfirmed for banks and payment institutions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If a banking analogue exists, it is a near-real-time governance-event channel; if not, the cell must fall back on decisions + commercial register.

negative_findings.description: English searches found ECB fit-and-proper methodology and aggregate sanctioning statistics, but no ECB publication naming individuals approved to Slovak bank boards.
negative_findings.result_summary: ECB fit-and-proper outcomes for Slovak significant institutions appear not to be published at person level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For ECB-supervised Slovak banks, the regulator gatekeeper thesis holds legally but yields no public name-level record; NBS decisions, ORSR and Obchodný vestník become the operative sources.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed bulk/API access for the NBS supervised-entity register or the decisions register; the decisions listing appears to be a filtered HTML table.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-network reconnaissance pass on subjekty.nbs.sk, registre.nbs.sk and the výroky filter to capture underlying JSON/XHR endpoints and pagination parameters before writing collectors.

coverage_gaps.description: ORSR and Obchodný vestník collection both require a watchlist of IČOs/ORSR IDs for every licensed SK bank, foreign-bank branch, payment institution and e-money institution. Only two example ORSR IDs were observed (VÚB, SZRB).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Materialise the watchlist by joining the NBS supervised-entity register and the EBA credit-institution/PSD2 registers, then resolve each to an ORSR ID and IČO once.

coverage_gaps.description: The NBS decisions filter exposes 'oblasť rozhodnutia' and 'druh rozhodnutia' facets whose allowed values were not enumerated in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the facet values and identify which correspond to prior-consent/personnel decisions so the collector can subscribe narrowly instead of ingesting all decisions.

coverage_gaps.description: Named individuals in regulatory decisions and commercial-register extracts are personal data; NBS/ORSR terms of use and any anonymisation practice were not reviewed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Review NBS and ORSR/justice.gov.sk terms of use and GDPR notices; define a retention and internal-use-only policy for person-level records before storage.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell covers appointments and governance changes but produces no signal on rank-and-file hiring volume, job postings or team build-out at SK banks and PSPs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure a sibling cell covers SK job boards (Profesia.sk, Kariera.sk, LinkedIn) and bank career pages; regulator sources cannot fill that dimension.

coverage_gaps.description: I did not establish the settled Slovak term set NBS uses for PSD2/EMI key function holders as opposed to banks' 'vedúci zamestnanec priamo podriadený štatutárnemu orgánu'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the controlled vocabulary from Opatrenie 6/2010 as amended and from the Zákon o platobných službách, and add it to the extraction glossary.

brief: In Slovakia the regulator-gatekeeper thesis holds legally but only partially in data: NBS must consent to bank and payment-institution board members and key function holders under §28 of the Banking Act, and it publishes the operative parts of those decisions in a dated, filterable register (výroky právoplatných rozhodnutí, plus a non-final and an archive tier and pre-2013 PDF compendia) — but as free text inside decisions, not as a person-level dataset, and no dedicated fit-and-proper register was found. The actor spine is strong and largely machine-readable: subjekty.nbs.sk / registre.nbs.sk and the PSD2 register enumerate every licensed bank, branch, payment and e-money institution and agent, mirrored and bulk-downloadable via the EBA credit-institutions and PSD2 central registers, while the ECB SSM entity list decides whether a given bank's appointment is decided in Frankfurt (no person-level publication) or in Bratislava. Because ECB fit-and-proper outcomes are not published by name, the operative confirmation layer for 'who holds which seat' is national: ORSR extracts for current state and Obchodný vestník for the dated change events. Highest-value next steps are confirming machine-readable endpoints on the NBS hosts, enumerating the decision-type facets, and materialising an IČO/ORSR-ID watchlist from the NBS and EBA registers.
